logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the 99mTc organometallic compounds (24-29) was determined by calculating the distribution coefficient (Do/w) with the shake-flask method. The 99mTc-complexes (10 µL) were mixed with 1 mL of 1-octanol and 1 mL phosphate buffer (PBS, 0.1 M, pH 7.4) in a centrifuge tube. The mixture was vortexed at room temperature for 1 min and centrifuged at 3500 rpm for 10 min. The radioactivity of aliquots (15 µL) of both 1-octanol and PBS phases were counted in a gamma counter. The distribution coefficient (Do/w) was calculated by dividing the counts in the 1-octanol phase by those in the buffer, and the results expressed as logD7.4 (Table 1).
